summary: All 49 source files passed integrity checks. Both RNA-seq panels answer the registered normal-chow ARC contrast at ZT4, and all 24 plotted directions agree. Only Fabp7 and Arntl pass registered BH < 0.05 among the 21 author-positive S4A genes, so I changed the inference status from `limited` to `different`. I also corrected the supplement length to eight pages. The `compared` closure applies to the selected genes. [JCI supplement](https://www.jci.org/articles/view/140424/sd/pdf/render/1)
openIssues: The full author chow DESeq2 table and exact model design remain unavailable. The cause of the 19 significance-call differences is unresolved.
The 24 RNA-seq directions fall below the 30-pair minimum for author-concordance-v2.
